name: UI — Ícono de Moneda (HUD, tienda, recompensas)
generation_strategy: IMAGEN INDIVIDUAL 1024×1024. Un solo ícono centrado en canvas transparente. Tight bbox crop → resize 24×24.

frames.prompt: A single cartoon HUD icon centered on a fully transparent background. The icon is a GOLD COIN for a game currency display. A perfectly round coin, viewed slightly facing the viewer. Rich warm gold (#FFD700) with strong cel-shading: a bright white specular highlight in the upper-left quadrant (taking ~25% of the face), smooth gradient to warm gold mid-tone, deep amber-orange shadow on the bottom-right. A bold 5-pointed star embossed in the center, slightly raised with its own subtle shadow. A thin bright golden rim ring around the edge. Bold dark charcoal outline, 4-5px. Instantly reads as GOLD COIN at 24x24px. Transparent background, nothing else.
